title: Thai Green Curry Tofu with Romaine, Cucumber, Edamame & Peanut Salad

steps.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Place curry paste, water, vinegar, and oil in a medium bowl. Stir to combine the sauce and set aside.

Large dice tofu. Place in another medium bowl, then sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper; toss to coat. Wipe baking sheet dry with paper towels, then return tofu to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer; drizzle with oil. (Wipe bowl clean with paper towels and set aside for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing once, until tofu is golden and warmed through, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Place in the reserved bowl.
Wash, dry, and chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the cucumber.
Place edamame in a colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; add to the bowl with the salad, along with the peanuts, and set aside.
When the tofu is done, remove from oven and add to the bowl with the sauce. Gently toss to coat.
Add peanut sauce to the bowl with the salad and toss to combine.
To serve, divide tofu and salad between plates. Enjoy!
